+    # Pairwise products of standard-normal-like inputs to capture interactions
+    p12 = x1 * x2
+    p16 = x1 * x6
+    p26 = x2 * x6
+    
+    # Squares to capture radial effects
+    sq1 = x1 * x1
+    sq2 = x2 * x2
+    sq6 = x6 * x6
+    
+    # Soft threshold features for uniform inputs [-2, 2]
+    # tanh((v - threshold) / scale) acts as a smooth step function
+    # Trying thresholds at 0 and +/- 1
+    t4_0 = math.tanh(x4 / 0.5)
+    t5_0 = math.tanh(x5 / 0.5)
+    t4_1 = math.tanh((x4 - 1.0) / 0.5)
+    t5_1 = math.tanh((x5 - 1.0) / 0.5)
+    t4_m1 = math.tanh((x4 + 1.0) / 0.5)
+    t5_m1 = math.tanh((x5 + 1.0) / 0.5)
+    
+    # Interaction between uniform inputs
+    p45 = x4 * x5
+    
+    # Interaction between normal and uniform inputs
+    p14 = x1 * x4
+    p25 = x2 * x5
+    p15 = x1 * x5
+    p24 = x2 * x4
+    
+    # Sign features for quadrant detection
+    s12 = math.copysign(1.0, p12)
+    s45 = math.copysign(1.0, p45)
